messages:
julia: FYI putting encoder pool "gencpu-a" on watch for tonight. We've seen 3 OOM restarts in the last 2h and a correlated spike in encode latency.

julia: Symptoms
- pods OOMKilled
- encode p95 from ~80ms -> ~600ms
- alerts: `encoder_memory_pressure` and intermittent `encoding_latency_p95` flashes

julia: Quick triage:
- prom: `sum(container_memory_rss_bytes{container="encoder"}) by (pod)`
- check datadog tags: `seq_length`, `batch_size`

nate: Confirmed. Memory spikes align with requests at seq_length ~12k from a partner. KV cache blows up and triggers OOMs.

nate: Immediate plan:
- limit max_seq via feature-flag `encoder_max_seq_limit=4096` on a canary pool
- monitor canary for 30m, then promote to d-1 if stable
- if OOMs persist, apply queue throttle: `rate_limit --qps 60`

kevin: I can roll the canary at 23:15 UTC (tag: `canary/enc-maxseq-4096`) and watch pod churn. Auto rollback if errors > 5%.

marta: Note: embedding service is seeing `embedding_cache_errors_high` (redis connector). Upstream retries are likely amplifying encoder load. Errors started ~21:45 UTC.

marta: Suggested alert tuning while we investigate:
- increase `for:` to 10m and threshold >8 to reduce flapping
- add grafana: `retry_backoff_count` to confirm retry amplification

julia: Good point. Throttling won't help if retries keep requeuing. Need infra to look at redis timeouts.

nate: I'll open infra task: INF-1342 `embedding-redis timeouts` and attach logs. Escalation rule: if embedding 5xx >10% for 15m -> page eng-sre.

oncall-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.com/encoder-ooms — follow 'memory spike' checklist, section 2 has rollback commands.

kevin: Roll started. Canary pods replacing now.

nate: Canary metrics: memory down ~30%, p95 latency trending down. Still watching for embedding retries.

marta: Silenced `embedding_cache_errors_high` for 30m while we validate baseline. Will update ticket INF-1342.

julia: Coverage: @nate until 09:00 PST. Escalation:
- `encoder_memory_pressure` >3x in 15m -> ping eng-sre + page
- encode p95 >500ms >20m -> open incident route to L1

nate: ack :white_check_mark: I'll update this thread every 20m or on critical.

kevin: If stable, promote canary to d-1 at 00:00 UTC and monitor 1h.

nate: Rollback command if needed:
```
redwood platform deploy rollback --service encoder --to-tag previous
```

nate: Signing off for now, watching graphs.
